notes.title: Winter Sale (& Build 1.08)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we hope you’re having a wonderful time. We have recently updated [b]Chronotopia: Second Skin[/b] with a new build [i](1.08)[/i] that fixes more typos, as well as lower the requirements to trigger the Fleur’s Goodwill achievement by another point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40813489/88225571d0b227262827d5b0e33c638bbe78f508.jpg[/img]

[h3]If you couldn’t buy [b]Chronotopia[/b] on launch, here’s your chance: it’s currently 10% off as part of the Winter Sale! Consider it a Christmas gift from us~ 🎁[/h3]

[h1]🥂 Merry Christmas & a Happy New Year! 🥂[/h1]

notes.title: Chronotopia Update - Build 1.05
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40813489/73249aab8b53c95bc238a02891d0762a74f8275f.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, we hope you’ve been enjoying [b]Chronotopia[/b]’s story so far! Ever since release, we’ve been gradually fixing issues. Here’s a summary:

[list]
[*] One reviewer noted a lack of content warnings despite the game’s heavy subject matters. Since this is an oversight on our part, we added a warning with this update. Upon launching the game for the first time, the warning will stay on-screen until the player takes action to ensure it will be less likely to be accidentally skipped. [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IENcTWem_8QQB86Qq3UiYtGkRUntd6C-1qWgPB25tm8/edit]A detailed list is also available on this page[/url] (be aware that it contains spoilers for the full game).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40813489/82a5dee00a30092c3131d35d558f8e5df0399e21.png[/img]

[*] One player reported to us that the [b]Archivist[/b] achievement would not trigger, preventing 100% completion. We applied a solution that had an unexpected side effect. Some players would randomly unlock the achievement without even completing the Archives or opening said menu. So we hurried to find another solution. The issue should be solved now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40813489/82fae4da2e7da1367063b9647b9e3e9ca722146a.png[/img]

[*] After a player pointed out to us that there was no room for mistake to trigger the [b]Fleur’s Goodwill[/b] achievement, we’ve decided to lower the requirements by one point.

[*] We fixed some typos that have been reported to us or that we noticed during Youtube/Twitch playthroughs.

[*] We changed the names of several backers in the credits, as per their request.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40813489/53c08e70d38a4f21691cc036495e36bee6c9e9c0.jpg[/img]

We also fixed a couple of minor bugs:
[list]
[*] The farm minigame would sometimes not be skipped on a second playthrough (exposing why it was restricted in the first place).
[*] If the player skipped dialogues fast enough, unnamed music tracks would appear in the "Currently Playing" pop-up, crashing the game.
[*] In one scene of the demo, Kionna’s sprite would appear on top of Nahima’s instead of the wanted position.
[*] In some cases, only one variation of the [b]Dead End[/b] would trigger (the one appearing in the [spoiler]Buried Alive[/spoiler] scene), creating confusion as to Nahima’s fate.
[/list]

Thank you again for the lovely reviews and the support ❤️. We would almost be hitting 10 reviews by now if press keys/developer keys counted but, unfortunately, they don’t. Steam rules are impenetrable sometimes. That being said, don’t hesitate to report bugs & typos directly to us so we can fix those in the next updates!
